The FloPlast push-fit air admittance valve is an essential component for efficient soil and vent drainage, allowing air into sanitary pipework while preventing foul gases from escaping into buildings. This 110mm grey air admittance valve is ideal for plumbing installations where external roof penetration for vent pipes is not feasible. Its robust uPVC construction ensures long-term reliability, and the simple push-fit connection streamlines installation for trade professionals. Operating reliably from -20° to +60°C, it can be fitted below connected appliance flood levels, offering flexible drainage project solutions. Recommended to not be used externally as environmental debris will affect the air tightness performance of the valve.
